gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Every stroke in Tourney is cut to one width, so the wide-tracked words look bent from wire. And Noto Sans Mandaic follows with curvy, loose letters whose lowercase climbs close to the capitals.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numerals:
Tourney is all bulky, stretched-out letters.

Noto Sans Mayan Numerals is its opposite: tall-bodied small letters and a gaping c, with hardly any calligraphic modulation, set against that heavy display heading.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Chunky, stretched, and sporty. Tourney spaces its oversized small letters wide, and Noto Sans Meetei Mayek answers with large lowercase eyes and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-myanmar:
Athletic through and through, Tourney fattens its crossbars to match its stems and stretches every word wide across the line.

Noto Sans Myanmar feels plain beside it.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-old-persian:
Tourney looks drawn with a single pen tip, every glyph the same bold line.

It shouts best when wide and loud, while Noto Sans Old Persian does its best work breathing quietly, with open counters and a lofty, tall lowercase.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-oriya:
Smooth, bold, wire-drawn lettering: Tourney keeps that look across a whole sentence, with oversized small letters and wide tracking.

Noto Sans Oriya, with generous curves, takes over.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-osage:
Tourney sets bulky, wide-tracked words in plain unshaded lines, giving the heading a blunt, athletic punch.

Noto Sans Osage swells its lowercase bowls into inflated, sweeping curves.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Tourney makes its joins as thick as its strokes, so each wide-tracked word hits like a block of bold type. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau lets open-ended curves breathe, with lowercase sitting just below the capitals.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa has c openings you can see through and only a gentle bump from small letters up to capitals. And over a long stretch that keeps the text easy, a quiet counterweight to Tourney's bold, wide-tracked heading.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-phoenician:
Wide, bold, and built from equal strips: that is Tourney.

Noto Sans Phoenician reads smoothly over a long stretch, its generous lowercase height and s curves opening wide at both ends.
